applications.name: Self-hosted osTicket
applications.policy: repository-controlled installation with synthetic users and tickets
applications.trafficBudget: local installation; restore every mutation and remove all synthetic tickets

tasks.oracle: The result contains the one seeded ticket ID matching both requester and department and no seeded decoy ID.
tasks.reset: Recreate the fixed synthetic ticket set before each demonstration and replay.

tasks.oracle: The osTicket database and a fresh staff page both show the exact synthetic assignee after commit and the prior assignee before commit.
tasks.reset: Restore the prior assignee and update timestamp after every replay.

tasks.oracle: The database and a fresh staff page show the exact ticket closed once; receipt reuse causes no second event.
tasks.reset: Reopen the exact ticket, remove generated thread events, and restore timestamps.

applications.name: Self-hosted WordPress
applications.policy: repository-controlled installation with synthetic posts and media only
applications.trafficBudget: local installation; delete synthetic content and restore settings after each run

tasks.oracle: The returned IDs equal the database query for the frozen author, category, and draft status, including one decoy exclusion.
tasks.reset: Recreate the fixed synthetic post, author, and category fixture before each run.

tasks.oracle: The media database row, attachment metadata, and fetched attachment page all contain the exact unseen alt text and file hash once.
tasks.reset: Delete the attachment and generated thumbnails and remove the allowlisted source copy.

tasks.oracle: The database and fresh admin page show exactly one future post with the requested UTC instant; receipt reuse creates no duplicate.
tasks.reset: Delete the exact synthetic post and associated metadata.

applications.name: Self-hosted Moodle
applications.policy: repository-controlled installation with synthetic courses, users, activities, and files
applications.trafficBudget: local installation; reset course state and remove synthetic files after each run

tasks.oracle: The exact returned user IDs equal a direct database query for the frozen course, group, and role; seeded decoys are absent.
tasks.reset: Restore the fixed role and group memberships before each run.

tasks.oracle: The submission row and Moodle file store contain one file with the unseen name, size, and SHA-256 only after commit.
tasks.reset: Delete the submission, file records, and content-store object for the exact fixture user.

tasks.oracle: A direct database query and teacher review page agree on one finished attempt, answer set, and deterministic score; receipt reuse changes nothing.
tasks.reset: Delete the exact attempt and usage records and restore question state.

applications.name: Self-hosted Discourse
applications.policy: official source in a local installation with synthetic users, groups, categories, and uploads
applications.trafficBudget: local installation; remove synthetic records and uploads after every mutation

tasks.oracle: Returned topic IDs exactly match a direct database query for all three filters across more than one page with no duplicate IDs.
tasks.reset: Recreate the fixed paginated topic and decoy fixture before each run.

tasks.oracle: The draft endpoint and upload record contain the unseen body token and exact file SHA-256 after commit and nothing at prepare.
tasks.reset: Delete the draft, upload record, and stored file for the synthetic user.

tasks.oracle: A direct database query plus fresh sessions for an allowed and denied synthetic user agree on the new permission exactly once.
tasks.reset: Restore the prior category-group permission and clear affected synthetic sessions.

applications.name: Self-hosted Nextcloud
applications.policy: repository-controlled installation with synthetic users and allowlisted files
applications.trafficBudget: local installation; remove shares, users, and files created by the task

tasks.oracle: The returned file IDs and paths equal an independent WebDAV/OCS listing and exclude a same-name decoy owned by another fixture user.
tasks.reset: Recreate the fixed two-user file fixture before each run.

tasks.oracle: The OCS share record and recipient session show one exact user share with edit permission only after commit.
tasks.reset: Delete the exact share and restore the source file metadata.

tasks.oracle: The OCS share record is absent and the recipient loses access after one commit; receipt reuse does not affect any replacement share.
tasks.reset: Recreate the frozen source share with its original ID-independent permissions.

applications.name: Self-hosted nopCommerce
applications.policy: official source in a local installation with synthetic products, customers, and orders
applications.trafficBudget: local installation; restore inventory and delete synthetic orders after each run

tasks.oracle: The returned variant and stock values equal direct database queries for the frozen attribute combination and warehouse; decoys are absent.
tasks.reset: Recreate the fixed products, combinations, warehouses, and stock quantities.

tasks.oracle: The database and a fresh admin page show the unseen exact quantity only after commit without changing another warehouse.
tasks.reset: Restore all prior stock quantities and update timestamps.

tasks.oracle: The database, order-note history, and fresh admin page show exactly one allowed state transition; receipt reuse adds no note or transition.
tasks.reset: Delete the synthetic order and its dependent records, then recreate it in the initial state.

applications.name: GOV.UK decision tools
applications.policy: read-only, low-volume, human-scale journeys after a same-day terms and robots review; no crawling or mutation
applications.trafficBudget: one demonstration pair and one unseen replay per service in a separately approved window; no performance distribution

tasks.oracle: The final eligibility branch and displayed amount fields match a separately scripted browser journey for the frozen synthetic answers.
tasks.reset: Start a clean anonymous browser context for each journey; the service creates no retained benchmark state.

tasks.oracle: The final loan components and eligibility branch match a separately scripted browser journey for the frozen synthetic answers.
tasks.reset: Start a clean anonymous browser context for each journey; the service creates no retained benchmark state.

tasks.oracle: The displayed benefit and tax-charge estimates match an independent calculation and separately scripted browser journey for the frozen synthetic answers.
tasks.reset: Start a clean anonymous browser context for each journey; the service creates no retained benchmark state.

applications.name: Operator-owned Google Form
applications.policy: form and destination are owned by the benchmark operator; synthetic responses only; creation and deletion require explicit operator authorization
applications.trafficBudget: two varied demonstrations, one unseen commit, and one duplicate-receipt check; then delete responses and form when authorized

tasks.oracle: The visited section titles and final review fields equal the owner-authored branching definition for the unseen answer path, with zero responses recorded.
tasks.reset: Use a clean respondent context and clear any draft response; never submit during this task.

tasks.oracle: The prepared preview contains the exact unseen text, date, choice, and scale values while the owner response count remains unchanged.
tasks.reset: Discard the respondent draft and reopen the unchanged owned form.

tasks.oracle: The owner response view or linked owned sheet contains exactly one row with the unseen nonce and field values; receipt reuse creates no second row.
tasks.reset: Delete the exact synthetic response and confirm the owner-side count returned to baseline.
